Base Year 2023 plus the three Regional Transportation Plan Needs-year
scenarios (2036, 2046, 2055), run against the v10.0-beta.2 TDM network. Each
scenario's curated segment-level summary (`_Summary_SEGID_filtered.csv`) is
committed under `runs/v10.0-beta.2/<scenario>/outputs/`.
